page.layout: One column of text on the right printed page. Running head at top centre. Woodcut ornament above the dedication title. Title block centred, then salutation, then body paragraph running on to the next page. Catchword and signature at the foot. No page number printed.

main_text.head: NOBILISSmo MAGNIFICOQ. DOMINO IOH. CHRISTOPHORO à GRYNIN WEIERSPERG. Serenissimi ELECTORIS Palatini ad Rhenum, &c. CANCELLARIO meritissimo: Domino meo gratioso.
main_text.p: GORGIAS Leontinus palliatorum disertissimus tantâ dicendi acrimoniâ, tantaque invenien-di ἀγχινοία[?] polluisse fertur, ut quemcunq; ponere sibi liberè iuberet, de quo quid audire, disseriq; à se cuperet, effecturum

page.notes: The Greek word ἀγχινοία is uncertain at the letter level and is marked [?]. The woodcut ornament above the title and the large G initial are not text, and the initial is read as GORGIAS. The faint grey ghost text along the right margin and the pale show-through are not printed text on this page and are left out. The catchword "se" is printed at the lower right. The signature is printed at the lower left as ")( ij".
